# All in One Edition
> All in One Edition is a browser-based hub with original games, a larger external game catalogue, an anime and cartoon episode tracker, Study Hub and an Elementor AI workspace.

Canonical website: https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/
Site description and frequently asked questions: https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/about

## Key public resources
- [Original browser games](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/browser-games): first-party 3x3 puzzles, Snake, tile merging and short arcade games
- [3x3 games and puzzles](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/3x3-games): original board puzzles and publisher-hosted minigame links
- [Watch episode tracker](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/anime): browse episode guides, track watched episodes locally and find official viewing options
- [Elementor AI](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/elementor): a browser AI chat and creative workspace
- [Study Hub](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/study): school-oriented tools
- [Full hub](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/): game catalogue and tools
- [XML sitemap](https://allinoneedition.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): indexable site pages

## Important distinctions
- All in One Edition does not claim to own publisher-hosted games or official anime.
- Not every listed Watch episode includes an in-page playable video. Uploaded videos must be authorised for distribution.
- Watch progress is a device-local checklist; users may export a backup.
- External games and video providers may have browser, regional or connection requirements.
- Elementor AI can make mistakes and may require sign-in for some operations.

This information is descriptive, not an assertion of Google ranking or AI search visibility.
